description: Archive a variant (soft delete: status becomes ARCHIVED, item is hidden from the storefront but restorable) or unarchive it (status becomes HIDDEN; publish it afterwards via update_variant). Success ({"ok":true}) only means the request was processed: for an unknown id or a transition that does not apply the API also answers 204 and changes nothing — confirm the new status with get_variant.
name: variant_action
title: Archive or unarchive variant
